headline: Committee discusses ESKAPE Plan, bike path survey, e-bike regulations, and 2027 CIP budget requests.
summary: The committee will review the ESKAPE Plan, bike path survey results, and rules on e-bike use and speed limits. It will also discuss neighborhood outreach for CIP projects, plan the 2027 CIP budget requests, and plan a way finding meeting with Parks and Rec, EDC, and HDC.
items: Discussion of ESKAPE Plan and next steps
Bike Path Survey discussion and update
Discussion of State and Town regulations on e-bike use and speed limits on bike path
Discussion of submission to Town Council for neighborhood outreach when CIP activity is planned
Discussion and planning of 2027 CIP and budget and requests from BPAC
Planning for way finding meeting with Parks and Rec, EDC, HDC
New discussion issues and future agenda items
location: 2nd Floor Conference Room, Town Hall, 180 High Street, Wakefield RI 02879
